message.entry: AVR_DC1 ''{0}'': the amplifier output {1} pu required at the equilibrium is not within the limits ({2}, {3}) pu. Widen Vap_min and Vap_max, change the operating point of the generator (for example its P or V) so that the required output falls within the limits, or set Limiter to false to ignore the limits of this AVR.

AVR_DC1 ''{0}'': the field voltage {1} pu required at the equilibrium is not within the limits [{2}, {3}] pu. Widen Vfld_min and Vfld_max, or change the operating point of the generator (for example its P or V) so that the required field voltage falls within the limits.
AVR_DC1 ''{0}'': kap is 0, so no reference voltage gives the amplifier output {1} pu required at the equilibrium. Set kap to a nonzero gain.
